subject: SIG/CAIQ: compact encryption evidence package & HSM operator-shift logs request
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aegisfin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@aegisfin.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifact ask (TLS, KMS/HSM, rotation samples)

Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG + CAIQ intake we need a compact evidence bundle focused on encryption and key management. The items we need for a first-pass review are:  

- A short TLS cipher inventory for public endpoints (hostnames + ciphers observed) covering the last 90 days.  
- Sample KMS/HSM rotation timeline (human-readable, with key IDs and rotation events) for the past 12 months; an abridged CSV is fine.  
- HSM operator shift logs for the systems that handle tenant KEKs (we need operator shift timestamps, shift id, and a signed activity note per shift; PII can be redacted).  
- Any HSM attestation or vendor-supplied seal statement you can share (PDF stub is fine).

Deadline: our external SIG reviewer is expecting an initial package by EOD next Thursday (2026-08-27). If that's not possible, a partial drop (TLS inventory + rotation timeline) by EOD Monday would be helpful.

Security notes: we prefer a presigned S3 link or an encrypted archive delivered to our SFTP endpoint. We will provide the SFTP details if that helps.

Attached is our intake form (Aegis_SIG_request_form.pdf) with checkboxes for the artifacts. Let me know if any of this is impossible to produce or if you need clarifications.

Regards,
Alex Mercer
Head of Vendor Risk
Aegis Financial

---
Attachment: Aegis_SIG_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aegisfin.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@aegisfin.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifact ask (TLS, KMS/HSM, rotation samples)

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact, redacted evidence package and a secure transfer mechanism. Proposed plan:  

1) Deliverables in first package (target: 2026-08-24):
   - tls_cipher_inventory_202605-202608.json (hostnames + observed ciphers + first/last seen)
   - kek_rotation_timeline_abridged.csv (key_id, rotation_event_ts, actor_id_redacted, reason)
   - hsm_shift_logs_202605-202608.csv (shift_id, start_ts_utc, end_ts_utc, activity_summary)
   - hsm_attestation_stub.pdf (vendor-signed seal statement)

2) Transfer method: presigned S3 link (72-hour expiry) or SFTP. We will default to presigned S3 unless you send SFTP details.

3) Redaction: we will redact operator personal identifiers and replace with internal shift IDs; we can include hashed operator fingerprints if you need traceability. Please confirm whether hashed operator IDs are acceptable.

4) Additional artifacts (can follow as an addendum): signed time-stamp log for rotation events and a short rotation runbook excerpt.

I will start packaging today. If acceptable, can we book a 25-minute sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT to confirm the scope of redactions?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifact ask — evidence packaging notes

Priya — looping in the packaging contents and a build I'm preparing. Draft inventory of files that will go into compact_evidence_digest_v1.tar.gz:  

- tls_cipher_inventory_202605-202608.json (generated by infra scans + load balancer TLS report)
- kek_rotation_timeline_abridged.csv (includes rotation_event_id, rotated_by_shift_id, previous_key_id -> new_key_id)
- hsm_shift_logs_202605-202608.csv (shift_id, start_ts_utc, end_ts_utc, signed_note_digest)
- hsm_attestation_stub.pdf (vendor-signed statement; redacted serials)
- runbook-rotation-abridged.md (1-page summary of process + emergency rewrap play)
- checksums.txt (sha256 for each file)

Notes:
- The shift logs will have operator names redacted; we will include shift identifiers and a hashed operator fingerprint column for audit traceability.
- The kek_rotation_timeline will include the internal KMS key aliases and the external key IDs necessary for your reviewer to map rotations; we will not include private key material.
- We'll sign the tarball with a timestamped GPG signature and provide the public key fingerprint in the S3 listing.

Jonas — can you confirm the hsm_shift_logs export includes the signed_note_digest field? If not, we will include the per-shift activity summary and the HSM event id to cross-reference.

Marissa
Director, Crypto Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: compact_evidence_digest_v1.tar.gz (application/gzip)
Attachment: runbook-rotation-abridged.md (text/markdown)
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aegisfin.com>

Cc: Audit Team <audit@aegisfin.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T08:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifact ask (follow-up)

Thanks, Priya and Marissa — that approach sounds good. Two quick asks before you ship:  

- Please make the presigned S3 link valid for 72 hours from the time of upload. We will coordinate ingestion on our side.
- Ensure all timestamps in shift logs are normalized to UTC and include an explicit timezone field. Our tooling relies on that.

If you can include a single point of contact for any follow-up technical questions (name + email + available hours), that will speed our review.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Alex

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aegisfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifact ask (final ack)

Alex — ack and confirmed. We will:  

- Publish presigned S3 link that expires in 72 hours.
- Normalize all timestamps to UTC and include timezone fields.
- Provide a single technical point of contact: Jonas Weber (jonas@redwood.com), available 9:00–17:00 PT.

We will send the initial package tomorrow (2026-08-21) morning PT. If you need the SFTP details instead, please send them today and we will switch transfer method.

Thanks,
Priya
